headlines.title: SKIMS and DoorDash: Solutions For Every Body, Delivered On-Demand
headlines.summary: SAN FRANCISCO & LOS ANGELES, September 08, 2026--Today, DoorDash (NASDAQ: DASH) and SKIMS announced a new partnership to offer on-demand delivery from all SKIMS retail stores across the U.S. Consumers can now shop more than 23,000 styles across shapewear, underwear, loungewear, and more from SKIMS stores on DoorDash, with delivery, on average, in under an hour.

headlines.title: Pet Supplies Delivery (2026): Same-Day Options for Pet Food, Litter, and Heavy Pet Essentials by Consumer365
headlines.summary: Consumer365 has released a new guide examining how same-day retail delivery can help pet owners manage routine restocks, urgent shortages, and heavier purchases such as bags of food and litter. The article looks at DoorDash as an example of how delivery apps now serve everyday shopping needs alongside restaurant orders.

headlines.title: Alex Kurland Joins Menlo Ventures as Partner
headlines.summary: Veteran Growth Investor Behind Clay, Datadog, DoorDash, Kalshi, Snowflake, and Other Category-Defining Companies Joins Menlo’s Inflection Team Alex Kurland Alex Kurland, Partner, Menlo Ventures MENLO PARK, Calif., Sept. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Menlo Ventures, a leading venture capital firm investing at the forefront of AI, today announced that Alex Kurland has joined the firm as a Partner on its Inflection team, where he will help lead the firm’s growth-stage investing practice.

headlines.title: Last-Minute Gift Delivery (2026): Same-Day Ideas for Birthdays, Flowers, and Small Gifts by Expert Consumers
headlines.summary: Expert Consumers has published a new review of last-minute gift delivery options, highlighting DoorDash as a practical choice for birthdays, flowers, celebrations, and other occasions when traditional shipping no longer fits the timeline.

description: DoorDash, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a commerce platform that connects merchants, consumers, and dashers in the United States and internationally. The company operates DoorDash Marketplace, Wolt Marketplace, and Deliveroo Marketplace, which provide various services, such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing, and customer support. It also offers consumer membership programs, DashPass, Wolt+, and Deliveroo Plus; advertising as a value-added service through its marketplaces; and white-label delivery fulfillment services, as well as services that help merchants establish online ordering, build branded mobile apps, manage reservations and in-store dining, manage consumer relationships, enable tableside order and pay, and improve customer support. The company was formerly known as Palo Alto Delivery Inc. and changed its name to DoorDash, Inc. in 2015. DoorDash, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
